index.title: Loads
index.subtitle: Every load you can see, and where each one is right now.
index.emptyHint: Once a load is created it will appear here.
index.noResultsHint: Clear the filters to see everything you have access to.
index.searchPlaceholder: Load number, reference, PO or commodity

detail.noAssignments: No truck or driver assigned yet.

money.feeBaseNote: Your fee is charged on the commissionable base — the carrier's gross rate less pass-through costs like permits and escorts.
money.feeBaseNoteGross: Your fee is charged on the full carrier gross rate, pass-through costs included.
money.noRateYet: No carrier rate agreed yet, so there is nothing to settle.

transition.illegal: This load is {from} and cannot make that move. Someone may have changed it in another tab — reload and try again.
transition.reasonRequired: Write down why this load is being cancelled — at least ten characters. It stays on the record.
transition.reasonLabel: Why is this load being cancelled?

blocking.noCustomerCharge: No customer charge has been set.
blocking.noCarrierRate: No rate has been agreed with the carrier.
blocking.carrierNotApproved: The carrier's onboarding is not approved.
blocking.driverNotCompliant: A driver's licence or medical card has expired, or the driver is inactive.
blocking.permitNotApproved: This is an oversize load and its permit has not been approved.
blocking.noPodDocument: No proof of delivery has been uploaded.
blocking.missingDocument: A required document is missing or not approved: {document}.

form.createSubtitle: A load is born as a draft. Publishing it, choosing a carrier and dispatching it are separate acts, each with its own checks.
form.editSubtitle: Changes apply from now on. What was already agreed with the carrier keeps its terms.
form.customerNotFound: That customer does not exist in this company.
form.oversizeHint: An oversize load cannot be dispatched until its permit is approved.
form.customerChargeHint: In dollars. What the customer pays. A load cannot be posted without it.
form.carrierRateHint: In dollars. Agreed when you choose the carrier.
form.financialsLocked: Only accounting can change the carrier rate and the percentages.
form.specialInstructionsHint: Sent to the carrier with the rate confirmation.
form.internalNotesHint: Your team only. Never shown to the carrier or the customer.
form.needsBothStops: A load needs at least one pickup and one delivery.
form.orChooseLocation: Or choose a saved customer location
form.noSavedLocations: This customer has no saved locations.

assign.title: Assign
assign.onlyApproved: Only carriers whose onboarding is approved appear here.
assign.rateHint: In dollars. This is what you are paying the carrier for this load.
assign.carrierDone: {name} is now the carrier on this load.
assign.carrierNotFound: That carrier does not exist in this company.
assign.carrierNotApproved: {name} cannot take loads: their onboarding is not approved.
assign.carrierLocked: This load has already been dispatched with this carrier. Changing it now is a different load.
assign.needsCarrierFirst: Choose the carrier first — trucks and drivers belong to a carrier.
assign.driverNotFound: That driver does not exist in this company.
assign.unitNotFound: That unit does not exist in this company.
assign.driverInactive: {name} is inactive and cannot be assigned.
assign.driverWrongCarrier: {name} does not drive for this load's carrier.
assign.unitWrongCarrier: Unit {unit} belongs to a different carrier.

requirements.title: Driver requirements
requirements.hint: What this load demands of whoever runs it. The system compares it against what is on each driver's record and reports meets / does not meet / not recorded — it never picks the driver for you.
requirements.sourceHint: The contract, base or customer that demands it.

eligibility.twicOk: TWIC on file and in date.
eligibility.twicNoExpiry: TWIC on file but no expiry recorded.
eligibility.endorsementOk: The endorsement is on the licence.
eligibility.endorsementMissing: The endorsement is not on the licence.
eligibility.endorsementNoValue: The requirement does not say which endorsement.
eligibility.licenceMissing: No licence on file, so the endorsements are unknown.
eligibility.workAuthMismatch: Recorded status is a different one.
eligibility.recordShort: Clean record is shorter than required.
eligibility.recordUnknown: The record has not been checked.
eligibility.stale: The check is over a year old.
eligibility.sourceMissing: This requirement does not say where it comes from.
eligibility.title: Against this load's requirements
eligibility.notABlock: This does not stop you assigning. It is what is on file today — go and check whatever is missing.

errors.requirementNeedsSource: A work-authorization requirement has to say where it comes from — the contract or base that demands it.
errors.requirementDuplicated: That requirement is already on the load.

rateConfirmation.title: Rate confirmation
rateConfirmation.description: The paper that states what this load pays, and what the carrier answered.
rateConfirmation.noneIssued: No rate confirmation has been issued for this load yet.
rateConfirmation.needsCarrier: Assign a carrier to the load first.
rateConfirmation.needsUser: A user account is required to respond to a rate confirmation.
rateConfirmation.historyEmpty: The carrier has not answered yet.
rateConfirmation.stale: The confirmation was reissued after this answer. What was accepted is no longer what stands — the carrier needs to answer again.
rateConfirmation.respondHint: Your account, the date, your IP address and a fingerprint of the exact PDF in front of you are recorded.
rateConfirmation.reasonRequired: Rejecting or requesting changes needs a reason. Without one, dispatch has to call to find out what happened.
rateConfirmation.legalNotice: This record stores who accepted, when, from what IP address, and a cryptographic fingerprint of the exact PDF shown. On its own it does not constitute a contract or legal advice.

documents.title: Load paperwork
documents.description: The bill of lading, the proof of delivery and the receipts from the trip. Each one can be tied to the stop it belongs to.
documents.fileHint: PDF or photo, up to {mb} MB.
documents.stopHint: Leave it on "whole load" if the document is not from one particular stop.
documents.detachHint: Detaching removes the document from this load. The document and its history stay stored.
documents.stopNotOnLoad: That stop does not belong to this load.
documents.listEmpty: Nothing has been attached to this load yet.
documents.podBlockedTitle: Proof of delivery cannot be marked as received yet
documents.podReady: A proof of delivery is attached: the load can now be marked as POD received.
documents.maxSize: The file cannot be larger than {mb} MB.
